---
title: 'Appendix D — Static estimator (Table D.1)'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, DIDmultiplegtSTAT)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Panel A: all switches

```{r}
ats <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = "aoss",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(ats)
```

## Panel B: program activations

```{r}
ats_plus <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = "aoss",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  switchers = "up",
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(ats_plus)
```

## Panel C: program closures

```{r}
ats_minus <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = "aoss",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  switchers = "down",
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(ats_minus)
```
